name: Back Office Desk
who: Solo owners and two-person businesses in the Netherlands who are doing their own inbox, scheduling, invoicing and supplier chasing after hours.
problem: "I do the actual work between nine and five and then the admin starts. Two evenings a week go on invoices and email that anyone could do, except there is no anyone."
solution: A monthly subscription that takes the recurring admin off their desk: inbox triage and drafted replies, scheduling, invoicing and payment follow-up, supplier and document chasing. Delivered by a small Dutch-speaking team whose throughput is multiplied by tooling we build and keep improving.
promise: The real work happens between nine and five, and then the admin starts. Your inbox triaged, your invoices sent and chased and your calendar managed, for a fixed monthly fee, in Dutch.
gets:
Inbox triage with replies drafted in your voice, ready to send
Invoicing and payment follow-up, plus supplier and document chasing
A monthly log of what was handled and the hours it gave you back
positioning: Local, Dutch-speaking and GDPR-clean at a price that offshore VAs set — because the tooling does the repetitive half and the people do the half that needs judgement.
voice: Discreet and reliable. Reports what was handled, not how hard it was.
channels: Referral from bookkeepers and accountants, LinkedIn to solo professionals, ZZP communities and networks
